title: Graded algebra isomorphism on an affine base open
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be commutative unital graded $\mathcal O_S$-algebra sheaves [def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], quasi-coherent as algebra sheaves [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra], with section rings and section gradings as in [def-nagata-relative-proj]. For an affine open $U\subseteq S$, a local graded algebra isomorphism from $\mathcal A$ to $\mathcal B$ on $U$ is specified on the affine basis by a pair of graded ring maps $\beta_V:\Gamma(V,\mathcal A)\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal B)$ and $\gamma_V:\Gamma(V,\mathcal B)\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal A)$ for every affine $V\subseteq U$. Both maps preserve the structural map from $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_S)$, are inverse to each other, and commute with restriction along every affine inclusion $W\subseteq V\subseteq U$. This is the affine-basis presentation of a graded $\mathcal O_U$-algebra sheaf isomorphism. Its inverse exchanges $\beta$ and $\gamma$; its restriction to an affine $V\subseteq U$ retains their components on affine opens contained in $V$.
